overview_description.description:
Salesforce enters intro definitive agreement to acquire Spindle AI, accelerating Agentforce, the enterprise AI platform: https://salesforce.com/news/stories/salesforce-signs-definitive-agreement-to-acquire-spindle-ai

Backed by Accel Partners (Cursor/Perplexity/Atlassian) and Caffeinated Capital (Airtable/Notion/IFTTT), Spindle AI (https://spindle.ai) is your intelligent copilot for agentic business analytics and scenario planning. Instantly place a virtual data scientist or operations analyst at the fingertips of every budget stakeholder to generate scenarios, simulate “what‑ifs”, summarize trade‑offs… and still have time for lunch. Spindle is lovingly built by machine learning & analytics entrepreneurs/engineers from Tableau, Google, Stanford University, Facebook, and others who share our mission to augment human cognition with intelligent analytics. Come shape the future with us: https://spindle.ai

about_short_description.short_description: Spindle AI’s agentic business analytics platform helps finance, ops, and revenue teams solve optimization & what-if questions in seconds.

identifier.value: Spindle AI Generative Business Analytics Platform

product.name: Spindle AI Generative Business Analytics Platform
product.description: A platform that enables Strategic Finance teams to generate, compare, and analyze thousands of business scenarios rapidly using AI agents and multidimensional data models.

identifier.value: AI Agents for Financial and Prescriptive Analytics

product.name: AI Agents for Financial and Prescriptive Analytics
product.description: AI agents that generate auditable scenario models, solve constrained optimization problems, and simulate business scenarios using quantitative methods within the Spindle platform.

product.name: Multi-Valued Assumptions (MVAs)
product.description: A feature that allows users to input ranged values instead of single-point assumptions to better capture uncertainty and variability in financial models.

product.name: Scenario Landscapes
product.description: A scenario analytics engine that systematically tests all relevant possibilities and constraints to simulate tradeoffs and pressure-test assumptions in enterprise forecasting.

product.name: On-the-Fly Multidimensionality
product.description: A tag-based data modeling feature that allows users to dynamically restructure and pivot financial models and analyses without extensive schema reconfiguration.

product.name: Fusion Data Engine
product.description: A data integration engine that harmonizes and processes large-scale relational and multidimensional data from multiple FP&A sources for unified analysis.
